intro: Are you looking for a comprehensive health insurance scheme that covers your medical expenses? Look no further than Ayushman Bharat Health Card! 🤑 Introduced by the Government of India, this scheme aims to provide health insurance coverage to economically vulnerable families. In this article, we will delve into the details of Ayushman Bharat Health Card, its eligibility, application process, and benefits. So, let's get started! 🚀

sections.heading: What is Ayushman Bharat Health Card? 🤔
sections.content: Ayushman Bharat Health Card is a health insurance scheme launched by the Government of India in 2018. The scheme aims to provide health insurance coverage to over 100 million poor and vulnerable families in India. The scheme is also known as Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PMJAY). The health card is issued to the beneficiaries, which can be used to avail cashless treatment at empaneled hospitals across the country. 🏥

sections.heading: Application Process 📊
sections.content: The application process for Ayushman Bharat Health Card is simple and straightforward. You can apply for the health card through the official website of Ayushman Bharat or through a Common Service Center (CSC). You will need to provide certain documents, such as your Aadhaar card, ration card, and income certificate. Once you have submitted your application, you will receive a health card, which can be used to avail cashless treatment at empaneled hospitals. 📈

sections.heading: Benefits of Ayushman Bharat Health Card 🤑
sections.content: The benefits of Ayushman Bharat Health Card are numerous. The scheme provides health insurance coverage up to ₹5 lakh per family per year, which can be used to cover medical expenses, including hospitalization, surgery, and diagnostic tests. The scheme also covers pre-existing diseases, maternity benefits, and new-born baby coverage. 🤰
